test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Ten people are sitting in two parallel rows 1 and 2. A, B, C, D and E are sitting in row 1 facing the South and V, W, X, Y and Z are sitting in row 2 facing the North, in such a way that each member in row 1 faces a member of row 2.

W sits at the extreme left end of the row. W faces an immediate neighbour of B. C sits at one of the positions to the left of B but not at the extreme end of the row. The one who faces C sits to the immediate left of Y. D sits third to the right of A. V sits to the immediate right of X. Who faces Z?
solution: **Given:** • A, B, C, D and E are sitting in row 1 facing the South. • V, W, X, Y and Z are sitting in row 2 facing the North. **Explanation:** • W sits at the extreme left end of the row. • W faces an immediate neighbour of B. • C sits at one of the position to the left of B but not at the extreme end of the row.
